cameraStyle.description: Clean, modern and premium framing with intentional movement.
cameraStyle.movement: Subtle and smooth (gimbal-like); avoid shaky or excessive motion.
cameraStyle.framing: Rule of thirds, generous headroom, subject on brand-colored or clean backgrounds.

animationStyle.description: Modern motion graphics with brand colors and smooth easing.
animationStyle.textAnimation: Kinetic typography for key phrases; fade/slide for supporting text.

transitions.pacing: Fast enough to retain attention, slow enough to comprehend.

backgroundMusic.energy: Medium-high for reels/shorts, medium for explainers
backgroundMusic.volume: Keep under narration; duck to ~15-20% when voice is present

subtitleRules.timing: Word or phrase level sync with narration

voiceRules.gender: Neutral / brand-consistent; keep consistent per series

sections.name: Hook
sections.purpose: Grab attention with a bold problem or promise

sections.name: Value
sections.purpose: Deliver the core insight or solution clearly

sections.name: CTA
sections.purpose: End with a brand-approved CTA from cta.json

branding.logoPlacement: Subtle corner watermark or intro/outro sting
branding.colorGrade: Clean, slightly premium; keep brand colors accurate
